reference.question: 统计衡阳市发电场站中火电场的装机容量
reference.query: SELECT SUM(installed_capacity) AS thermal_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE area_id LIKE '4304%' AND energy_type_code = 'THERMAL';

predicted.query: SELECT SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_installed_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id JOIN common.station_type_dict std ON es.station_type_code = std.type_code WHERE ad.city_name = '衡阳市' AND std.type_name = '火电';

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 查询各发电场站中装机容量超过同类型平均装机容量的场站名称

steps.query: SELECT es.station_name, es.installed_capacity, et.type_name FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE es.installed_capacity > (SELECT AVG(es2.installed_capacity) FROM energy.energy_station es2 WHERE es2.energy_type_code = es.energy_type_code);

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 统计各发电场站类型的平均装机容量

steps.query: SELECT st.type_name, AVG(es.installed_capacity) AS avg_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.station_type_dict st ON es.station_type_code = st.type_code GROUP BY st.type_name;

knowledge_in_actual_prompt.knowledge_text: 场站类型代码映射：PP=发电厂，SUB=变电站，TL=输电线路，DS=配电站，WP=风电场，SP=光伏电站，HP=水电站，NP=核电站，ES=储能站，CC=集控中心。发电类场站包括PP、WP、SP、HP、NP。

raw_knowledge_not_in_actual_prompt.knowledge_text: 能源类型分类：火电(THERMAL)、水电(HYDRO)、风电(WIND)、光伏(SOLAR)、核电(NUCLEAR)、生物质发电(BIOMASS)、天然气发电(GAS)、抽水蓄能(PUMPED)、地热发电(GEOTHERMAL)、氢能(HYDROGEN)。清洁能源包括水电、核电、天然气发电、抽水蓄能，新能源包括风电、光伏、生物质发电、地热发电、氢能。可再生能源包括水电、风电、光伏、生物质发电、地热发电。
